text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.N. special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, said UNITA deputies and members of the new integrated government would arrive in the capital Luanda on Wednesday.
- African Development Bank officials said in Namibia that Angol had to first settle its debts before additional loans were made to it.

- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos and the head of Mozambique's national assembly, Eduardo Mulembwe, held talks on Monday on the possibility of a working relationship between their two parliaments.
